sources.title: Digital Realty Selected to Develop 50 Megawatts of New Data Center Capacity in Singapore (Digital Realty press release, 24 August 2026)
sources.summary: The dateline is 24 August 2026. Digital Realty states that Singapore has three operational data centres with approximately 84 MW of combined capacity. The operator metro page identifies those three as SIN10, SIN11 and SIN12; its 2020 release identifies SIN12 as the third and explicitly places it adjacent to SIN11 in the Digital Loyang campus. This is a current operational observation for the existing two Loyang buildings. The separate planned Jurong Island fourth facility and the aggregate 84 MW are not assigned to the Loyang record.
sources.date_semantics: Dated 24 August 2026 in the dateline (sitemap lastmod 25 August 2026 UTC). The present-tense 'three operational data centers' statement is used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 24 August 2026; the Jurong Island facility is a separate future project not covered by this record.
sources.capture_note: Canonical metadata from the identical URL/content-hash capture already in the base dataset is preserved to reuse its evidence ID. The local raw capture and metadata retain this review capture provenance.

geometry_facts.method: SIFT feature matching, Lowe ratio 0.7, affine RANSAC threshold 3 target pixels

geometry_facts.review: Visually matched the mosque, distinctive IT Park Phase I buildings and road layout in both images. Registered point lies in the small excavation immediately north of the mosque, distinct from the much larger pink Phase II construction area and the red buffer plot. Imagery date unknown; geometry only.
